template_meta.name: Farewell_Clearance_Letter
template_meta.description: A stark all-white, plain-text 'breakup letter' ad that personifies a clearance, urgency, or transformation moment as a farewell message, anchored by an oversized emoji pairing and a bottom logo band composited in post-production.

user_inputs.logo_image: [UPLOAD LOGO IMAGE — leave the bottom band blank in generation and composite this on top afterward, do not let the model redraw the logo]
user_inputs.body_paragraph_1: [INSERT PARAGRAPH 1 — set-up / reason for the moment]
user_inputs.body_paragraph_2: [INSERT PARAGRAPH 2 — stakes / why it matters now]
user_inputs.headline_font_family: [INSERT BRAND HEADLINE FONT, e.g. Playfair Display Black — falls back to a bold monospace/typewriter font if the brand has no serif]
user_inputs.body_font_family: [INSERT BRAND BODY FONT, e.g. Graphik Regular]
user_inputs.bold_font_family: [INSERT BRAND SEMIBOLD/BOLD FONT, e.g. Graphik Semibold]

rendering.style: native emoji glyphs, rendered large (~90px each), no background shape
leave this band blank during generation; composite the real logo asset on top afterward for pixel accuracy

generative_image_prompt: A 1080x1350px (4:5) all-white advertisement styled as a plain-text 'farewell letter', laid out top to bottom on a pure {user_inputs.background_color_hex} background with generous whitespace and no product photography, no borders, no drop shadows. TOP (starting ~6% down): two large native emoji glyphs side by side, centered — {user_inputs.emoji_primary} and {user_inputs.emoji_secondary} — rendered at roughly 90px each, plain, no background shape behind them. BELOW that (~30% down), a two-line centered headline in {user_inputs.headline_font_family}, color {user_inputs.text_color_hex}, reading: '{user_inputs.headline_line_1}' on the first line and '{user_inputs.headline_line_2}' on the second line, generous line-height. BELOW the headline (~45%-87% down), three short centered paragraphs of body copy in {user_inputs.body_font_family} at regular weight, color {user_inputs.text_color_hex}, comfortable line-height (~1.5), each paragraph separated by a full blank line: paragraph one is '{user_inputs.body_paragraph_1}' with the phrase '{user_inputs.bold_phrase_1}' rendered in {user_inputs.bold_font_family} inline; paragraph two is '{user_inputs.body_paragraph_2}' with the phrase '{user_inputs.bold_phrase_2}' rendered in {user_inputs.bold_font_family} inline; paragraph three is a short closing line, '{user_inputs.body_paragraph_3}'. All body text wraps naturally within a centered column roughly 82% of the canvas width. Render every word of the body copy exactly once verbatim — do not insert, duplicate, or repeat any extra words anywhere, especially immediately before or after bolded phrases. Proofread the rendered text carefully before finalizing. BOTTOM (final 14% of canvas height): leave this band completely blank, plain {user_inputs.background_color_hex}, with no text, no shapes, and no gradient — the brand's real logo file is composited on top afterward in post-production rather than rendered by the model, for pixel accuracy. The overall mood is minimal, text-first, and pattern-interrupt in style — deliberately looking like a plain note or letter rather than a polished commercial ad, with no imagery beyond the two emoji and the typography itself. Output: 1080x1350px, 4:5 aspect ratio, RGB, flat digital illustration/typography style, no photographic elements.
generation_notes: Approved variant swaps the original source ad's monospace typewriter font + gradient wordmark bar for the client's actual brand fonts and a post-composited real logo file (see reverse_engineered_from client example: Pure Peony, Aug 2026). Prefer this approach over letting the model render logo/wordmark text directly.
